# Assignment datasets

- `assignment-nz-sa1-2018-part-3a-total.xlsx` is the Stats NZ 2018 Statistical Area 1 workbook used by the [Chapter 1 assignment instructions](../01-geographic-information.Rmd). The instructions use the Territorial Authority tab to obtain the paid employee field. See the [Stats NZ release page](https://www.stats.govt.nz/information-releases/statistical-area-1-dataset-for-2018-census-updated-march-2020).
- The companion 2018 Territorial Authority boundaries and paid-employee CSV are in `territorial-authority-boundaries/` and `paid-employee/`. Their filenames begin with `assignment-`. The assignment instructions link the [New Zealand spatial data portal](https://datafinder.stats.govt.nz/) for the boundary download.

Chapter 1's fly-tipping example data is labelled `course-` and documented in [Chapter 1 course data README](../course-data/README.md).
